name: Golomyanka (oilfish)
desc: Translucent, live-bearing deep-water fish and the most numerous fish in the lake. They rise toward the surface at night to feed on copepods and amphipods.
about: Comephorus, known as the golomyankas or Baikal oilfish, are a genus comprising two species of peculiar sculpin fishes endemic to Lake Baikal in Russia.
